name: mohavetech-contracts
features: Draft a contract with wording help that cleans up text or drafts from a plain description, with use this wording or keep mine.
Draft link copies so the other party can open it.
Party A and party B sign by drawing on signature pads, with clear.
The signed contract's fingerprint records on Polygon, with retry if recording fails.
Verified records open by link and download a signature card image.
